move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you very much for your quotation for the stainless pump shaft SH-220 and for your kind words about building a partnership. We appreciate the care you put into your offer and would like to find a fair arrangement that works well for both sides.

We would like to propose three packages for your consideration:

- Option A: EUR 13.12 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, delivery DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 12.52 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, delivery EXW
- Option C: EUR 12.99 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, delivery DAP Hollerau

Option C offers faster payment, which may suit your cash flow. Please let us know which package fits you best.

To help us understand your pricing better, could you send us your cost breakdown for this part?

We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
Please let me explain.
We welcome your Option C, as the 14-day payment term aligns well with our needs.
To move closer to your price expectations, we must change the delivery term to EXW.
Alternatively, with delivery EXW: €16.50 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our whole team is ready, and we will do everything to make you a satisfied customer.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
